name: Pyu Ancient Cities
description: Scattered across the dry plains of the Irrawaddy basin in Myanmar, Halin, Beikthano and Sri Ksetra were brick-walled, moated cities of the Pyu people, who thrived here for over a thousand years, from about 200 BC to AD 900. Today you can see partly excavated palace sites, burial grounds, crumbling walls and towering brick stupas, plus old irrigation works that farmers still use.
